page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, consisting of 3126 GB of SSD capacity. This bundled local storage provides high-capacity, low-latency data access directly on the host. For external connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, supporting steady data transfer rates for distributed environments.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i1.14xlarge offers a balanced ratio of compute to memory alongside a large local SSD allocation. This hardware profile is suitable for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity and moderate memory density without the overhead of external storage attachments. Appropriate workloads include relational and non-relational databases, local data processing, and general-purpose applications that require high-capacity local scratch space.
